verdict.rationale: Docs confirm card issuance and management is part of the same API platform as accounts (synctera-docs-4, synctera-docs-7), consistent with the story's core ask. However, there's no explicit evidence distinguishing virtual vs. physical card issuance, spend controls, or digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning. Missing for 10: explicit virtual/physical card type documentation, spend control API details, digital wallet tokenization/push-provisioning support.
